content: We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve IR spectra or NMR to infer carbonyls. However simplest: use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch. But we need count. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we need the molecule structure? Not provided. Maybe the environment has a sample "at hand". The tools operate on "sample at hand" without needing SMILES. So we can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count carbonyl peaks. Or IR to see number of C=O stretches. Use carbon_nmr_spectra first (cheaper than HSQC). Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
